macros.name: defaultdesc
macros.doc: To allow document designers to control the global appearance of description lists, the \defaultdesc command may be redefined; it is called while setting up a new basedescript list, before performing the user’s declarations.

macros.name: multilinelabel
macros.doc: The label is typeset in a parbox with the appropriate width; if it won’t fit on one line, then the text will be split onto subsequent lines.

macros.name: nextlinelabel
macros.doc: If the label is too wide to fit next to the first line of text, then it is placed on a line by itself; the main text is started on the next line with the usual indentation.

macros.name: resume
macros.doc: The \suspend and \resume commands allow you to temporarily end a list environment and then pick it up where you left off.
